name: retirements
description: Every readable row of VerraRetirements_<date>.csv, values exactly as delivered (text, nothing cleaned).
grain: One row per record in the file: one range of credits retired, i.e. claimed against someone's emissions.

columns.name: program
columns.description: Crediting programme, e.g. Verified Carbon Standard.

columns.name: retirement_date
columns.description: Date the credits were retired, as delivered, e.g. '17 Nov 2010'; blank on a few rows Verra flags.

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Verra project ID.

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Project name.

columns.name: sectoral_scope
columns.description: Sectoral scope or scopes; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: methodology
columns.description: Methodology code(s) with version, e.g. 'ACM0002 (Version 10)'.

columns.name: additional_certifications_labels
columns.description: Extra labels on the credits, e.g. CCB or CORSIA; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: sustainable_development_contributions
columns.description: Sustainable Development Goals the project claims; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: vintage
columns.description: Year, or 'YYYY - YYYY', of the period in which the reductions happened.

columns.name: serial_number
columns.description: Serial-number range of the retired credits; sits inside one issued batch.

columns.name: retirement_qty
columns.description: Number of credits retired in this record, as delivered.

columns.name: unit_type
columns.description: Unit type, e.g. VCU.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region as reported by Verra; sometimes blank or inconsistent.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country as reported by Verra.

columns.name: state_province
columns.description: State or province as reported by Verra.

columns.name: beneficial_owner
columns.description: Who the credits were retired for, as typed by the account holder; often blank or a placeholder.

columns.name: retirement_reason
columns.description: Reason category chosen at retirement, e.g. 'Retirement for Person or Organization'.

columns.name: retirement_reason_details
columns.description: Free text about the retirement; may contain line breaks.

columns.name: validation_status
columns.description: Verra's own check of the row, e.g. PASS or FLAG.

columns.name: validation_issues
columns.description: What Verra's own check found, e.g. 'missing Retirement Date'.
